text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in their DM. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's 5 Oct 2025 "Sunday prep for Ruth" note. The gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard wasn't sending text-message bay assignments to drivers. It was patched on 4 Oct 2025.
- **#4419**, from Moss's undated North cheat sheet. Gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14. It was escalated to tier-2 support.

I also told Dana three things:
- The cheat sheet has no date, so I couldn't say when #4419 was opened.
- The Central notes mention other tickets (#4409, #4412, FR-882), but those belong to Marrow, a Central team account, not Quarrendon Freight Lines.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (spelled with one r) is about a competitor that isn't a customer, so I left it out.

All of Moss's notes are public files, so nothing came from places Dana can't see. Ticket numbers count as operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed.
